lines.text: You know there's a fire inspection this week, right? You'll need to be home.
Recycling day changed. I put up a notice…
Did you pick up your parking sticker?
We've had some noise complaints, so we're asking everyone to be careful.
If anything's bothering you, just let me know anytime.

flushRemark.text: You okay? You look a little flushed.

closers.parried: Oh, you're busy. Let's talk later.
closers.endured: So just keep that in mind~
closers.awkward: …Okay, well, just keep that in mind.
